**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd

**ITS Vice Presidency Context**

The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w

**Department Context**

The Operations & Country Engagement Solutions (ITSOE) department in ITS deliver’s innovative products and solutions to frontline staff, business partners and clients with a global delivery model.

  

We are seeking an experienced, and versatile Product Owner (ET Consultant) to join our growing team. The Product Owner will collaborate with end users and business partners to understand and anticipate their needs and translate them into product requirements; define the product vision and use inspection and adaptation to iterate through versions; create a product roadmap; oversee all stages of product creation including design and development; manage the product backlog and prioritize based on evolving business and institutional needs; and use data to monitor and evaluate product progress at each stage of the process.

The product owner will also write effective user stories and liaise with the product team and end users to deliver updates and participate in scrum meetings and product sprints; use feedback loops to get information about the product from real users and rely on analytics to make data-driven decisions.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, strategists, designers, solution architects, other product owners, and developers with an emphasis on strengthening the client centric service delivery for the related business areas, within the context of best practices in enterprise architecture, modern sourcing techniques, modular design of solutions, and appropriate integration of IT services and platforms.

We are looking for an individual who will bring a sense of client and product obsession to the team and who will ensure that our solutions meet or exceed expectations and deliver tangible business value.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Engage with business stakeholders to fully understand their needs and challenges and translate them into viable product requirements and features.
* Create product vision, product roadmap and maintain and prioritize product backlog and user stories based on the requirements.
* Drive the product execution to bring the product vision to life in collaboration with solution architects, developers, designers, and other cross-functional teams when applicable.
* Manage relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment on product direction.
* Deliver regular status updates to clients, identify and address risks, and reflect changes in requirements and priorities.
* Plan and execute updates and future releases through a data driven and agile approach.
* Prepare estimates and communicate costs, oversee all stages of the product development, and lead the user acceptance testing process.
* Actively engage with the Design and the Digital Acceleration teams to monitor and incorporate various needs and requirements, industry trends, and user feedback into the product.
* Assess impact to end users and need for change management.
* Develop product KPIs that are measurable, actionable, and aligned with business goals and users’ objectives.
* Actively monitor client needs, industry trends, Bank priorities, KPIs, and user feedback.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, combined with a minimum of 5 years product management experience, or bachelor’s degree with 7 years of product management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong understanding of business goals and the ability to translate them into product requirements.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and operationalizing product strategies and managing the full product lifecycle.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and strong understanding of Agile planning tracking tools such as Azure DevOps.
* Proven track record of successfully developing and launching technology products in large-scale environments.
* Solid understanding of IT development lifecycles and methodologies.
* Proven ability to collaborate with other team members across boundaries and contribute productively to the team's work and output, demonstrating respect for different points of view.
* Able to use strong interpersonal and teamwork skills to cultivate effective and productive relationships and partnerships across organizational boundaries.
* Proven ability to define and track key performance indicators relevant to the product and the business goals.
* Mastering data analytics tools to measure client satisfaction, team velocity, and product metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, proficiency in creating concise reports, and presentations.
* Strong presentation and collaboration skills with proven record of leading meetings and influencing stakeholders in multicultural environments.
* Passion for innovation and staying up to date with the latest technology trends.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities.
* Able to take personal ownership and accountability to meet deadlines and achieve agreed-upon results and has the personal organization to do so.
* Proficiency in English.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies

title: Senior Engineer - GBS IND
description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview**

Global Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives and Structured Products. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies. In addition, GMT provides Sales, Electronic Trading, Trade Work Flow, Pricing, and Market Risk, Middle office, Collateral Management, Credit Risk, Post-trade confirmation, Settlement and Client service processes for Trading, Capital Markets, and Wealth Management businesses.

FX electronic trading technology contains a suite of applications, with a complex eco system, architecture, multiple business flows, upstream and downstream dependencies. This is a critical institutional front office trading application supported 24 by 5 supporting all global locations for FX business.

  
  

**Job Description:**

The successful candidate will join the India development team of FX electronic trading technology.

Individual contributor role; is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for solutions at the program or portfolio level to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities include design/delivery of critical strategic complex business projects along with the India team. Continuously improving the design, quality, and reuse of the solution and delivering technology enablers that improve development efficiencies for the solution. They are experts in at least one area of engineering and acts as a "go-to-” reference across the organization. As experts, they play a role in improving technical competency in their area through recruitment and development activities.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

Leads the planning, definition, and design of complex features which span multiple teams and explores solution alternatives.

* Creates ideas on designing complex technology and solution development approaches - e.g., boundary condition coverage for complex technology issues.
* Help validate the economic impact of design decisions.
* Leads technical oversight for teams in solution development including design reviews and code within own domain.
* Supports/mentors/coaches’ team(s) on design and best practices for high code performance e.g., pairing, code reviews
* Accountable for defining the technology tool stack for the solution within range of internally approved and supported technologies.
* Explores state-of-the-art technologies to improve development efficiencies, quality of test/QA coverage, and release management.
* Leads and is responsible for the end-to-end test strategy/creation/adherence, and the integration between teams for a program/portfolio solution.
* Enables a program/portfolio solution with CI/CD capabilities and release management; Responsible for maximizing reusability, ensuring process optimization and efficient functioning of CI-CD pipeline.
* Optimize and tune existing modules for better performance
* Collaborate with product owners, scrum masters, testing teams throughout the SDLC process.
* Fully leverage AI tools during the SDLC cycle with clear measurable delivery velocity improvements

  

**Requirements**

**Education:** Graduate / Postgraduate in Computer Science engineering or equivalent

**Certifications If Any** :NA

**Experience Range :**14-20 years

**Foundational skills**

* Hands-on Software Development in C++ preferably on UNIX/Linux in a distributed application environment
* Strong in C++ application design and development that includes strong multi-threading
* Experience in front office electronic trading applications
* Strong FX domain experience/expertise
* Strong Algorithms and Data structures
* Strong in Design patterns and their use in distributed systems development
* Strong in application architecture concepts/patterns/uses
* Knowledge and experience with message-based systems (Tibco RV/IBM MQ/Zero MQ)
* Experience using AI assisted development tools with good prompt engineering skills
* Strong SQL and related DB skills – indexing, transaction management (Sybase/Oracle/MS SQL)
* Good in NO SQL databases, distributed caching technologies and their use
* Strong in system design concepts for a distributed application development
* Hands on experience in scripting languages like Python/Perl.
* Strong UNIX command knowledge including experience in writing shell scripts
* Strong working knowledge of leveraging CI/CD pipelines in SDLC
* Knowledge of Cloud architecture principles
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  

  

**Desired skills**

* Strong communication skills
* Flexible to adopt new technologies

  

**Work Timings:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

**Job Location:** Chennai/Mumbai

description:

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Location:

Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

We are seeking an experienced **Software Quality Engineering (SQE) / SDET Manager** to lead and drive quality strategy, test automation, and product qualification efforts. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in test automation and quality engineering, coupled with proven leadership experience managing QA/SDET teams. This role requires close collaboration with Development, Product Management, and Program Management teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable software solutions.

  
  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of QA Engineers, SDETs, and Qualification Engineers, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and performance coaching.
* Define and execute the overall quality engineering, test automation, and qualification strategy.
* Drive end-to-end testing activities, including functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end validation.
* Develop and enhance scalable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality is built into the software development lifecycle.
* Monitor quality metrics, drive defect prevention initiatives, and ensure release readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity through automation, tooling, and **AI/GenAI-assisted** testing solutions.
* Drive continuous process improvements and establish best practices for software quality and qualification.
* Be willing to work in a **techno-managerial role** , with significant hands-on technical contributions ( **~60% technical and ~40% people management responsibilities** ).
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field** .
* **12+ years of overall experience** in Software Quality Assurance, Software Qualification, SDET, or related quality engineering roles.
* **Minimum 2-3 years of experience managing QA/SDET/Qualification teams.**
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as **Selenium, Playwright** , and unit testing frameworks such as **TestNG** .
* Strong understanding of API, Integration, System, Regression, and End-to-End testing.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as **Azure DevOps, Jenkins** , or equivalent platforms.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and leadership skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with cloud/cloud native technologies around containers & orchestrations technologies such as dockers & Kubernetes.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI-based testing and quality engineering solutions.

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular

**Travel:**

Yes, 10% of the Time

**Relocation Eligible:**

Yes

Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
